title: Codimension zero: blow-ups of an integer multiplicity n-current in ℝⁿ converge to c[[ℝⁿ]] (Constancy Theorem)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity T), x ∈ U with x ∉ spt ∂T (x ∉ boundarySupport T), and λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0. Then there is C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝⁿ) such that the blow-ups S_j := η_{x,λ_j#}T (blowUp T x λ_j) satisfy S_j ⇀ C in ℝⁿ (ConvergesWeakly), μ_{S_j} → μ_C for all integer multiplicity representations (MassMeasuresConverge), C is minimizing in ℝⁿ (IsMinimizingIn C univ; in particular C is integer multiplicity) and ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C). (In fact C = c[[ℝⁿ]] for some c ∈ ℤ.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid n), 0 < n → IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → x ∈ U → x ∉ boundarySupport T → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C
